titleQuestion: We Look… But Do We See?
concepts: Do You See What I See?
heroLine: Do You See What I See?
tagline: Less… so you may see more.
heroSub: Fine-art photography from Chicago, the lakefront, and the wild places between.
intro: Wildlife at sunrise, the streets of Chicago, a beloved pet, a quiet moment between people — photographs drawn to the beauty most of us pass by.
lessIsMore: We look… but do we see?

bio.heading: Welcome to my world
body: For me, photography is not about recording what is in front of the camera. It is about discovering what others may pass by.

Whether I am photographing wildlife at sunrise, the streets of Chicago, a beloved pet, or a quiet moment between people, I am drawn to images that tell a story, evoke an emotion, or reveal beauty in the ordinary.
My goal is simple: to create photographs that encourage us to slow down, look closer, and see more.
After a lifetime of caring for patients as an optometrist, photography has become another way of helping people see the beauty of the world.

edisms: We look… but do we see?
Do you see what I see?
Beauty within shines outside; beauty outside only shines.

prints.statement: Prints are available on request. Each is printed to archival standards and signed. Write to me, tell me which picture spoke to you, and we will find the right size and paper for your wall.
